source_trace: A preparation ticket carries presentation owner and a nonzero globally increasing sequence; sequence overflow is rejected and clear_residency retains the counter. Starting an owner preparation clones its active products into staged state and sets the new preparing ticket.

Worker receipt obtains staged products only for the current matching ticket; finish also rejects stale tickets and checks the selected scene digest or city document. Activation requires the matching completed ticket and input identity before replacing active products.

Starting a new preparation does not erase a previously completed snapshot; a matching completed ticket may still activate while a new ticket is preparing. Cancellation removes only matching staged or completed state. This is a source-level lifecycle trace, not a concurrency execution.
